content_en.prompt: Ram built 9 towers of blocks (same height per block, different widths per tower). Changing a tower's height (adding/removing blocks from the top) costs energy = width × number of blocks changed. Ram wants all towers the same height, minimizing total energy.
content_en.question: What is the minimum total energy needed to make all towers the same height?
content_en.explanation: Setting all towers to height 3 (not the median height 4!) costs the least: 39 units total, because towers have different widths so the median height isn't necessarily optimal. Since the cost function is unimodal (single minimum), a ternary search can efficiently find height 3 as optimal without checking every height.
content_en.ct_explanation: Each pile of blocks is a stack, supporting push/pop operations — useful in many algorithms beyond block-building, such as evaluating arithmetic expressions. Finding the minimum-cost solution among all possibilities is an optimization problem; since the cost here is unimodal, ternary search (a divide-and-conquer algorithm) efficiently narrows down the answer by repeatedly eliminating outer thirds of the search range.

content_zh.prompt: Ram用積木蓋了9座塔（每塊積木高度相同，但每座塔的積木寬度不同）。改變一座塔的高度（從頂端加或拆積木）所需能量＝寬度×變動的積木數。Ram想讓所有塔都變成同樣高度，並且花費的總能量越少越好。
content_zh.question: 把所有塔調整成同樣高度，最少需要花費多少總能量？
content_zh.explanation: 把所有塔都調整成高度3（不是中位數高度4！）花費最少，總共39單位能量——因為每座塔寬度不同，中位數高度不見得是最省能量的答案。由於這個成本函數是「單峰」的（只有一個最低點），可以用三分搜尋法有效率地找到高度3就是最佳解，不用一個個高度都算過。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 每疊積木其實就是一個「堆疊」(stack)，支援「推入」跟「取出」操作——這種結構在很多演算法裡都很有用，不只是疊積木，例如計算算術運算式的值也會用到。在所有可能性裡找出成本最低的解，這叫做「最佳化問題」；因為這裡的成本函數是單峰的，可以用「三分搜尋法」（一種分治演算法）有效率地縮小搜尋範圍，每次都排除掉搜尋區間兩端各三分之一的部分。
